This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BellinghamFall2024#47420-competitor-responsibilities) tab.
**All students of Western Washington University may register free of charge! Please pay for your registration as normal, then [contact us](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/contact?competitionId=BellinghamFall2024&contactRecipient=competition) with a picture of your student ID to receive a full refund.**
